$comment: The GM tool contract. ONE copy, two languages: TypeScript imports it via @deliberate/protocol (GM_TOOLS) and the Python GM service loads it and passes the entries straight to the Anthropic `tools` parameter. Entries are exactly {name, description, input_schema} so no key has to be stripped before the API call; the query/mutation split is the two arrays, not a field. Every input_schema sets additionalProperties:false and lists every property in `required` (optional arguments are nullable rather than absent) because the service calls the model with strict schemas. Decision 2 of docs/m1-swarm.md.

queries.name: get_state
queries.description: Read the authoritative world state. Free and read-only: it never changes anything and never consumes a die roll. Use it before deciding anything; never guess at positions, hit points or whose turn it is.

scope.description: world: flags, quests and the clock. entities: every creature with its components. initiative: turn order and the current turn's economy. map: the tile grid as ASCII rows plus who stands where. all: everything (large; prefer a narrower scope).

entity_id.description: With scope 'entities', return only this entity. Null for all of them; ignored by the other scopes.

queries.name: legal_actions
queries.description: Everything this entity may legally do right now, computed by the engine's own validators: how far it may still move and to which tiles, which targets it can attack or cast at with which weapon or spell, and whether it may end its turn. Rejected options come back with the reason the engine would give. Free and read-only.

entity_id.description: The entity whose options to enumerate.

queries.name: line_of_sight
queries.description: Whether a straight line from tile a to tile b is unobstructed, plus the distance between them. Free and read-only.

a.description: Origin tile. Integer grid coordinates; x runs east, y runs south.

map.description: Map id. Null picks the only loaded map, and errors if more than one is loaded.

queries.name: path
queries.description: Shortest 8-way walking route from tile a to tile b costing at most max_cost tiles, avoiding walls, steep steps and occupied squares. One tile is 5 ft. Free and read-only.

max_cost.description: Budget in tiles; each step, diagonal or not, costs one.

map.description: Map id. Null picks the only loaded map.

queries.name: recall
queries.description: Search the world record for what is already established about a topic: world flags, quests and their current step, entities and their dialogue seeds. This is the engine's memory of facts, not your narrative memory. Free and read-only.

topic.description: Case-insensitive substring to look for in flag keys, quest ids, titles and steps, entity ids and names.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return, in a stable order.

queries.name: roll_preview
queries.description: The odds of a prospective attack or spell attack: the attack bonus, the target's AC, whether advantage or disadvantage applies and why, the chance to hit, the chance to crit, and the expected damage. Computed analytically from the rules — it does NOT roll and does NOT consume the seeded RNG, so calling it never changes what the real roll will be. Free and read-only. If the action would be illegal you get the engine's rejection reason instead of odds.

kind.description: attack: a weapon attack. cast: a spell attack.

ability.description: Weapon key for kind 'attack' (e.g. longsword), spell key for kind 'cast' (e.g. fire_bolt).

mutations.name: move
mutations.description: Walk an entity to a tile. The engine validates the route, the movement budget and the turn order, and rejects anything illegal without changing the world. Maps to the same validated `move` intent the player's UI sends.

mutations.name: attack
mutations.description: Make a weapon attack. The engine rolls it from the seeded RNG, applies damage and spends the action (or the bonus action for an off-hand light weapon). The first attack starts an encounter and rolls initiative. Maps to the validated `attack` intent.

ability.description: Weapon key from the trimmed SRD table: unarmed, club, dagger, handaxe, mace, shortsword, longsword, greataxe, shortbow, longbow. The attacker must carry it unless it is natural.

mutations.name: cast
mutations.description: Cast an attack cantrip at a target. Resolves through the same validated attack pipeline as a weapon: range, line of sight, action economy, a seeded attack roll and damage. Maps to the validated `cast` intent.

spell.description: Spell key from the trimmed cantrip table: fire_bolt, ray_of_frost, eldritch_blast.

mutations.name: say
mutations.description: Have an entity speak. This is the one mutation that changes no world state: it emits a dialogue line for the player to read and leaves the state hash untouched. The engine still validates it, so a dead or unknown speaker is rejected.

text.description: What they say, in their own voice.

to.description: Who they address. Null for speaking to the room.

mutations.name: set_disposition
mutations.description: Move how one entity feels about another by a delta. The engine clamps the result to [-100, 100] and records your reason. Maps to the validated `set_disposition` intent.

toward.description: Who they are feeling it about.

delta.description: Change to apply. Positive is warmer; the result is clamped to [-100, 100].

reason.description: Why it changed, in one short phrase. Recorded with the diff.

mutations.name: spawn
mutations.description: Place a new creature from a known template onto a tile. The engine rejects unknown templates, blocked or occupied tiles and duplicate ids; if an encounter is running the newcomer rolls initiative and is spliced into the order without changing whose turn it is. Maps to the validated `spawn` intent.

template_id.description: Key of a template the engine was configured with. Unknown templates are rejected; the reply lists the known ones.

at.description: Tile to place the creature on. Must be on the map, walkable and empty.

map.description: Map id. Null picks the only loaded map.

entity_id.description: Id for the new entity. Null derives a unique one from the template id.

mutations.name: set_flag
mutations.description: Set a world flag: the durable record that something happened. Maps to the validated `set_flag` intent.

key.description: Flag name. Reuse an existing key rather than inventing a synonym; call recall first.

mutations.name: advance_quest
mutations.description: Move a quest to a later step. The engine rejects unknown quests, steps out of range and any step that is not strictly forward of the current one. Maps to the validated `advance_quest` intent.

step.description: Index into the quest's steps. Must be greater than the current step and within range.

mutations.name: end_turn
mutations.description: End the acting entity's turn and pass initiative on, skipping the dead and anyone with no brain that can act. Maps to the validated `end_turn` intent.
